data.gender_notes: Cati is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'katharos', meaning 'clean' or 'purified'. In Christian tradition, this name is associated with the virtue of purity and the saint Catherine of Alexandria. The name Cati carries the meaning “Pure” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cati usually hope their child will grow to embody pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of spiritual cleansing and purification.
data.etymology: Cati belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cati total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: קטי
in_hebrew.meaning: מלכה קטנה, גברת קטנה, שם נשים מעט מוכר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מקור השם קטי בעברית ישראלית, נוצרה כגרסה קצרה של שם המלכה קטלינה. השם קטי נמצא במקורות היהודיים-נוצריים, והוא מייצג את האופי המלכותי, הנשי והקטן. במסורת הנוצרית, קטי נחשב כשם נשים מעט מוכר, אך הוא משקף את המשמעות הבסיסית של 'קטנות' ו'נשיות'.

in_greek.name: Κάτι
in_greek.meaning: μικρή βασίλισσα, γυναίκα μικρή, σπάνια ονομασία γυναικών
in_greek.long_meaning: Η λέξη Κάτι προέρχεται από την ελληνική ονοματολογία, και είναι μια συντομογραφία του ονόματος Κατελίνα. Η λέξη Κάτι εμφανίζεται σε πηγές της ελληνο-χριστιανικής παράδοσης, και αντιπροσωπεύει την ομορφιά της μικρότητας και της γυναικείότητας. Στην πρώιμη χριστιανική εποχή, το όνομα Κάτι ήταν σπάνιο, όμως έπαιξε σημαντικό ρόλο στην παράδοση των χριστιανικών ονομάτων.

in_latin.name: Cati
in_latin.meaning: rex parvus, mulier parva, nomen mulierum raro usitatum
in_latin.long_meaning: Cati provenit a Latinitate, et est forma brevis nominis Catherina. Nomen Cati in fontibus Christianorum antiquis invenitur, et significat elegantiam parvitatis et femininitatis. In primis aetatibus Christianorum, nomen Cati erat raro, sed in traditione nominum Christianorum, erat locum dignum.

in_english.name: Cati
in_english.meaning: small queen, little woman, rarely used female name
in_english.long_meaning: Cati is derived from the Latin name Catherine, and represents the beauty of smallness and femininity. As a given name, Cati is associated with the virtues of kindness, compassion, and strength, making it a popular choice among Christian families.
